immutable_ground_truth.statement: CHG-142 enabled the invoice_export_batching_v2 flag for us-east billing-export workers at 2026-06-11T22:30:00Z.
The flag merged adjacent customer-account shards into one batch when the invoice-row count was between 18,000 and 21,000.
The flag deferred the downstream index write until the merged batch finalized.
The flag ran the duplicate-payment warning check before the deferred index commit.

The lease conflict on billing_status_index produced a sequence of failures: invoice rows written, duplicate-payment warning attempted before index commit, downstream-index waited for same lease, worker retried until 900-second timeout.
Early retries emitted duplicate_payment_warning; later attempts emitted downstream_console_index_missing because the support-console index had not been committed.
Rolling back CHG-142 restored per-shard export commits and moved the duplicate-payment warning check after each shard-level index commit.
Batches b-7108, b-7109, and b-7110 completed below 400 seconds with no error code after rollback.
This note supports a common mechanism for duplicate_payment_warning and downstream_console_index_missing in this fixture.
The note does not claim the same mechanism applies outside the synthetic operations dataset.

source_summary: CHG-142 enabled invoice_export_batching_v2 for us-east billing-export workers at 2026-06-11T22:30:00Z, merging customer-account shards into batches of 18,000-21,000 invoice rows, deferring the downstream index write until batch finalization, and running the duplicate-payment warning check before the deferred index commit. A lease conflict on the billing_status_index caused failures: the duplicate-warning branch and downstream-index branch both attempted to hold the same lease, leading to retries until a 900-second timeout. Rollback restored per-shard commits, and batches b-7108, b-7109, b-7110 completed below 400 seconds with no error code. The note supports a common mechanism for duplicate_payment_warning and downstream_console_index_missing in this fixture, but does not claim the mechanism applies outside the synthetic dataset.
